title: Diffs vs. Whole Files: An Empirical Comparison of Iterative Edit-Based and Direct Generation for Flutter/Dart Code Models
abstract: arXiv:2609.05779v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large language models used for code editing can be trained and deployed in at least two output regimes: direct generation, where the model emits the entire modified file in one shot, and iterative diff-based generation ("steps"), where the model emits a sequence of localized search/replace edits applied one at a time until it signals completion or a step budget is exhausted. The diff-based regime is attractive because it mirrors how developers edit code and should require far fewer generated tokens per turn. We train two code models - a 100M-parameter model trained from scratch (Rainbow-Pony-100M) and a fine-tuned Qwen2.5-Coder-0.5B - in both regimes on a shared Flutter/Dart dataset, and evaluate all four resulting models on a held-out set of approx 1,790 tasks per model. Direct generation substantially outperforms diff-based generation on every metric we measure - compilation/static-analysis pass rate, bits-per-byte, character-level s

translated_title: 差异补丁与完整文件对比：Flutter/Dart 代码模型中迭代式编辑生成与直接生成的实证比较
translated_abstract: 用于代码编辑的大型语言模型可以以至少两种输出模式进行训练和部署：直接生成，即模型一次性输出整个修改后的文件；以及基于迭代的差异补丁生成（“步骤”），即模型输出一系列局部搜索/替换编辑，逐个应用，直到模型发出完成信号或步骤预算耗尽。基于差异补丁的模式很有吸引力，因为它更贴近开发人员编辑代码的方式，并且每轮所需的生成 token 数量应当少得多。我们在共享的 Flutter/Dart 数据集上以这两种模式训练了两个代码模型——一个从零开始训练的 1 亿参数模型和 一个微调的 Qwen2.5-Coder-0.5B——并在每个模型约 1,790 个任务的保留测试集上评估了所有四个模型。在我们测量的每一项指标上——编译/静态分析通过率、每字节比特数、字符级——直接生成都显著优于基于差异补丁的生成
tldr: 实证比较表明，在 Flutter/Dart 代码模型中，一次性直接生成完整文件的方式在编译通过率、信息效率等所有指标上都显著优于迭代式差异补丁编辑生成方式。
en_tdlr: Empirical comparison shows that direct whole-file generation substantially outperforms iterative diff-based edit generation on every metric for Flutter/Dart code models.
